statement: Claude Pro can generate several thousand to tens of thousands of lines of code per month depending on usage, model, context size and task type.
src/extract/prompt.js performs a second redaction stage: everything sent to a provider passes through redact() independently of capture-time redaction, and uses a fixed cache-friendly system prompt.
rationale: Observed in source audit of extraction prompt code.

statement: Groq structured outputs support strict json_schema only on some models; schema-mismatch responses return HTTP 400 'Generated JSON does not match the expected schema'. Rate-limit headers expose RPD/TPM; gpt-oss-20b is 30 RPM / 1K RPD / 8K TPM / 200K TPD.
rationale: Fetched from live Groq docs during session.

statement: Update L-1bbf8cb8: Groq limits confirmed live — 429s on TPM (8,000 tokens/min) are retried successfully after a wait; daily limit of 1,000 RPD confirmed.
rationale: Rate-limit handling is now confirmed working live.

statement: After a quota/credit error MEMO sets a cooldown pause that blocks all provider runs (including Groq) until the cooldown expires; `src/llm/limits.clearCooldown()` clears it, and saving a new key also clears the cooldown.
rationale: Error message says 'no API call before 19:15'; assistant cleared cooldown via limits.clearCooldown(); key.js save calls limits.clearCooldown().

statement: scripts/codebase-summary.js: first run (or --full) sends tracked files (~101 files, ~126k input tokens) to build a full summary; later runs send previous summary + git diff since the base commit + untracked files. Base commit is stored as a comment on line 1 of codebase_summary.md. Model can be changed via MEMO_SUMMARY_MODEL env var. All content passes through src/redact.js; .specstory/, transcripts, *.patch, memory/ and *_key.md are excluded.
